properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on 0.87.0 and 0.88.0): the "no export was kept current" line never names .reflow2.toml, though call_export::find reads it second, because the line was written on 2026-10-03 (#661) and #691 (2026-10-06) added the .reflow2.toml source to find() and its doc but not to unconfigured(); nothing ties the line's list to the resolver's
properties.statement: Field limitation 22 (VS Code --call run, 2026-10-19, 0.87.0). OBSERVED, reproduced on 0.87.0 and 0.88.0 with --graph-path <dir>/mystore/graph outside any repo: "reflow2: no export was kept current — no --export-to was given, and no MCP configuration in <dir>/mystore (.mcp.json, opencode.json, .vscode/mcp.json, .grok/config.toml) names one for this design. The write is in the store; pass --export-to <FILE> to keep the committed export current." With mystore/.reflow2.toml holding [export] path = "design.json", the next write printed "export written to …/mystore/design.json (created; named by .reflow2.toml [export] path)". CANDIDATES: (A) unconfigured() predates the .reflow2.toml source and was never updated — CONFIRMED: `git log -S"no export was kept current"` touches only af7a20a87 (#661, 10-03); #691 (75ce623df, 10-06) added source 2 to find() and the module doc and changed no line of unconfigured(). (B) the toml is read from a different folder than the hint names, so naming it would mislead — REFUTED: find() and pointer::location_for both use wall_check::project_root(graph_path), and the measured run wrote the export from the folder the hint names. (C) outside the component: the field binary predates #691 — REFUTED: 0.87.0 reads the toml (measured). (D) observation wrong — REFUTED: reproduced verbatim. CLASS: a user-facing line that enumerates the options a resolver reads, kept by hand apart from the resolver; the only test (with_no_export_named_anywhere_a_write_says_so_and_writes_none) pins "--export-to" and nothing about completeness, so adding a source could never fail it. The same shape as fact:root-cause-the-export-path-has-no-owner-so-writes-the-hook-and-init-disagree-2026-10-06, one layer out: #691 gave the path one owner and left its explanation with two. NOT ESTABLISHED: whether other refusals enumerate sources by hand in the same way (not swept). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
